notes.title: Bonds of Yachiyo is now available to purchase!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44021791/2cb0107a810c809073bc4d6187080566830d76f7.png[/img]

Hello everyone!

The day has come for darkness to befall the land: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922180/Bonds_of_Yachiyo/]Bonds of Yachiyo[/url] is now officially available to purchase! We’re celebrating the release of our first horror game with a special 20% off discount! Thanks so much for your support!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2922180/Bonds_of_Yachiyo/

Trailer:[previewyoutube=sLEV00m6Pkk;full][/previewyoutube]

Immerse yourself in a true horror experience crafted by Aoi Tsuyukusa as you follow the fall of two best friends into a dark, twisted world inhabited by vengeful spirits of the past. Hide and escape from monsters, solve puzzles and find clues to unravel the mystery!

Should you enjoy our games, consider joining us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/EaqZEsP3pV]Discord[/url] and following our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/Saikey]Steam Publisher Page[/url] for all the latest news from Saikey Studios!
